title: Distordia Article Standard
description: Schema for long-form articles stored as linked-list asset chains on the Nexus blockchain. A root asset (distordia-article) holds metadata and the first text chunk, while continuation assets (distordia-article-chunk) carry subsequent text and a 'next' pointer, forming a singly-linked list.
maxSize: 1KB per asset (system fields use ~180 bytes, ~820 bytes available for data)

assetTypes.description: Root article asset. Holds article metadata (title, tags, content warning) and the first text chunk. Points to the first continuation chunk via the 'next' field.

text.description: First text chunk of the article body. Max 384 characters for root asset due to metadata overhead.

reply-to.description: Address of post or article being replied to.

quote.description: Address of post or article being quoted.

next.description: On-chain address of the next article-chunk asset. Empty string if this is the only/last chunk.

assetTypes.description: Continuation chunk for long articles. Carries text and a 'next' pointer to the following chunk. The last chunk has 'next' set to empty string.

text.description: Continuation text chunk. Max 768 characters (lean structure allows more text per asset).

next.description: On-chain address of the next chunk asset. Empty string for the last chunk in the chain.

chunking.description: Articles are split into a linked list of on-chain assets. Chunks are created in reverse order (last chunk first) so each chunk can reference the address of the next one.

examples._comment: Short article fitting in a single root asset
examples.title: Introduction to Decentralized Identity
examples.text: Decentralized identity puts users in control of their digital presence. Rather than relying on centralized platforms...

examples._comment: Long article root pointing to continuation chunk
examples.title: The Future of Agent-to-Agent Commerce
examples.text: As AI agents become more prevalent in business operations, the need for trustworthy agent-to-agent commerce grows...
...continued text from the article. Verifiable agent identities enable secure multi-party transactions without intermediaries...

nexus.reassembly: Follow the 'next' pointer chain starting from the root asset, concatenating each chunk's 'text' field to reconstruct the full article.
